Figure 2: Overview of the MEMVISTA construction pipeline. Project scenarios and state schemas
define the setting, while state operations specify its evolution. Images and turn-by-turn user–agent
interactions realize this progression as multimodal histories. The completed histories and validated
state records support four task families: snapshot, trajectory, boundary, and reasoning.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed final full export and read caption plus all paired-image checks. Both source rows retain six stages, 5/20/4/3/4 counts, dates and S0–S3 operations, complete JSON/schema example and website layouts, user/tool conversation, trajectories and valid-range plots. Three added banners restate the caption verbatim in substance. No new inter-panel arrow or unknown state relationship added; both full original rows independently replayed at integer scale.
